_provenance.source: agy's own run logs, ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/log/cli-<stamp>.log, on a WSL host, read without running agy
_provenance.versions: signInNotRestored: agy 1.5.14 (2026-11-23). signInNetworkError, signInRestored, modelAlias: agy 1.4.10 (2026-11-20, 2026-10-29). Every message text used here is also present in the installed 1.5.14 binary's string table.
_provenance.note: Each string is ONE log line copied verbatim; nothing is substituted or invented. Only lines that carry no path, account, token or prompt were taken, so none needed sanitizing. signInNotRestored is a broker `agy models` run that the broker killed at its 15 s timeout after agy's saved sign-in stopped refreshing; signInNetworkError is such a run that also logged why; signInRestored and modelAlias are runs from before the sign-in expired. The `You are not logged into Antigravity.` line is kept in the healthy runs on purpose: agy logs it during startup even when the sign-in is then restored, so it is not a signal.
